name: Pendleton, 12 Year
serverNotes:
🤠 📖 ABOUT: Premium 12-year Canadian rye bottled in Oregon. 80 proof. Named after famous Pendleton Round-Up rodeo! Western-style with rodeo character.

🥃 PROFILE: Smooth & Approachable | Caramel, vanilla, butterscotch & subtle spice | Less aggressive than Kentucky ryes | Canadian ryes = smoother & sweeter | Mellow, rounded flavor.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: KC BBQ, grilled tri-tip, apple pie, caramel desserts.

💡 SERVING: Perfect for cocktails (Whiskey Sours, Old Fashioneds) or neat. Great intro to rye for bourbon drinkers!
location: Hood River Distillers, Hood River, OR (Canadian whisky, bottled in Oregon)

name: Sazerac
serverNotes:
🍸 📖 ABOUT: Classic Kentucky straight rye from legendary Buffalo Trace. 90 proof. Named after THE cocktail! Essential rye every bartender respects.

🥃 PROFILE: Bold & Spicy | Intense rye spice, clove, black pepper & bright citrus | Traditional, flavorful, unapologetically spicy | High rye content = signature bite | This is what proper rye tastes like!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Charred ribeye, 70% dark chocolate, aged Gruyere, spiced nuts.

💡 SERVING: THE rye for authentic Sazeracs or Manhattans! Essential for cocktail programs.

name: High West
serverNotes:
⛰️ 📖 ABOUT: Utah straight rye blend from High West. 92 proof. First legal Utah distillery since 1870! At 7,000 feet elevation. Revolutionized American rye blending!

🥃 PROFILE: Smooth & Assertive | Bold spice, fresh mint, caramel & black pepper | Expertly blended ryes | Perfect balance | Mint notes surprisingly refreshing!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Western BBQ brisket, elk medallions, wild game, dark chocolate truffles.

💡 SERVING: Great for Rye Old Fashioneds or neat with large ice. Mountain whiskey pioneers!
location: High West Distillery, Wanship (Park City), UT

name: Knob Creek Small Batch
serverNotes:
🔥 📖 ABOUT: Full-bodied Kentucky straight rye from Knob Creek. 100 proof! Pre-Prohibition style - rye at full strength & full flavor!

🥃 PROFILE: Bold & Robust | Intense rye spice, deep oak, caramel & barrel char | 100 proof creates intensity & warmth without harshness | Knob Creek doesn't compromise!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Bone-in ribeye, Texas BBQ burnt ends, hand-rolled cigars, bourbon barrel-aged coffee.

💡 SERVING: Perfect for Manhattans/Boulevardiers or serious rye drinkers! Maximum flavor!
location: James B. Beam Distilling Co., Clermont, KY

name: WhistlePig Piggyback, 6 Year
serverNotes:
🐷 📖 ABOUT: Vermont 6-year straight rye from WhistlePig - America's premier rye specialist! 96.56 proof. The farm that made rye cool again!

🥃 PROFILE: Bold & Smooth | Rye grain, fresh mint, caramel & black pepper | 100% rye mash bill | No corn diluting the rye character | Intense but balanced!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Smoked pastrami, applewood bacon, aged Gruyere, dark chocolate bark.

💡 SERVING: Perfect for Sazeracs/Manhattans where rye needs to shine! Craft excellence.

name: Mad River "Revolution"
serverNotes:
🏞️ 📖 ABOUT: Vermont craft straight rye from Mad River Distillers. 90 proof. Vermont's first distillery since Prohibition (2013)! Small-batch, traditional methods.

🥃 PROFILE: Smooth & Distinctive | Bold spice, caramel, vanilla & pepper | Green Mountains terroir | Vermont rye with personality! Outside Kentucky mainstream.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Vermont BBQ, maple-glazed pork, grilled meats, dark chocolate.

💡 SERVING: For rye enthusiasts seeking something unique! Supporting local craft excellence!

name: Mad River Silver Oak Barrel
serverNotes:
🍷 📖 ABOUT: Unique Vermont rye finished in authentic Silver Oak wine barrels from Napa! 92 proof. Limited production - only when barrels available! Vermont meets Napa Valley.

🥃 PROFILE: Complex & Innovative | Rye spice, red fruit, oak tannins & vanilla | Wine barrel finish creates wine-whiskey hybrid | Remarkable depth & fruit character rarely found in rye!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Venison, wild boar, aged Manchego, dark chocolate truffles.

💡 SERVING: For whiskey adventurers! Perfect neat. Mad River's experimental program!

name: Short Path, "Concord Straight Rye"
serverNotes:
🍽️ 📖 ABOUT: Massachusetts straight rye from Short Path, Everett (Boston area). 90 proof. Historic whiskey territory - MA had thriving rye pre-Prohibition!

🥃 PROFILE: Smooth & Flavorful | Rye spice, caramel, fruit & black pepper | Grain-to-glass, local ingredients | Distinctively New England | Small-batch craft.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: New England seafood, Boston BBQ, lobster rolls, apple cider desserts.

💡 SERVING: Great for cocktails or neat! Supporting local New England distilling!

name: WhistlePig
serverNotes:
🐷 📖 ABOUT: Premium 10-year Vermont straight rye from WhistlePig. 100 proof! WhistlePig's flagship - pioneered the rye renaissance!

🥃 PROFILE: Bold & Sophisticated | Intense rye spice, caramel, vanilla, oak & fresh mint | 100% rye mash bill | 10 years patience creates exceptional depth | Benchmark that set new standards!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Dry-aged steak, wild game meats, premium cigars, dark chocolate.

💡 SERVING: For serious whiskey lovers! Sip neat to appreciate world-class craftsmanship.

name: The Boss Hog by WhistlePig, "XI The Juggernaut"
serverNotes:
🐗 📖 ABOUT: Ultra-premium Boss Hog XI 'The Juggernaut' from WhistlePig. Barrel strength (108-115 proof)! Only ~3,000 bottles worldwide. WhistlePig's masterpiece!

🥃 PROFILE: Extraordinary & Complex | Rye spice, caramel, dark fruit, oak & char | Aged 13+ years, finished in Teakwood casks | Uncut, unfiltered | Collectible ceramic pig bottle | Absolute rye perfection!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Finest dry-aged beef, white truffles, premium cigars, single-origin dark chocolate.

💡 SERVING: For serious collectors & once-in-a-lifetime celebrations only! Neat - water would be sacrilege!
